question: package watts and C-state activity against request rate, steady and bursty, with a timer-only control
instrument: RAPL package-0 energy counter (intel-rapl sysfs, read-only bind into the container); C-state time and usage from /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpuidle summed over all CPUs, /proc/stat busy fraction, scaling_cur_freq every 2 s

software.origin: Node http server and a separate open-loop Node generator in the same container

method.order: shuffled per round with an idle window at the start, middle and end
method.bursty: the same count issued back to back once per period
method.timer set: a generator that fires its timer with no network and no origin (and a null route), at 50, 200 and 1000 per second, steady and bursty
method.data: synthetic: enroll.sqlite (60 departments, 24 terms, 6,000 courses, 60,000 sections, 120,000 students, 1.8M enrollments, seeded) and cms.sqlite (5,000 nodes)

exclusions: windows where other containers used more than 100 ms of CPU per second
